Inventory: event recording in s15_integrated_harness/trace_runtime.py

2. BaseTraceRecorder.emit / .span — :125/:129 — disabled-recorder stubs returning a placeholder event id / inert span when tracing is off.
3. TraceRecorder.__init__ — :191 — creates the run's JSONL trace file (0600) and emits the run_start event.
4. TraceRecorder.new_id — :252 — allocates sequential, prefixed evt_/span_ ids under a lock.
5. TraceRecorder._write — :258 — serializes one record to JSON and appends+flushes it to the trace file under a lock.
6. TraceRecorder.emit — :267 — assembles a full event record (timestamp, monotonic elapsed, run/turn/agent/span context, sanitized data) and writes it, returning its event_id.
7. TraceRecorder.span — :317 — context manager emitting paired start/end span events with duration, status, and error info on exceptions.
8. TraceRecorder.safe_value — :451 — redacts secrets and truncates oversized payload values before they are recorded.
9. TraceRecorder.summarize_output — :482 — builds a redacted, sha256-hashed preview (or full) payload for output events.
10. TraceRecorder.finish_run — :495 — emits the run_end event, then flushes and closes the trace file atomically.
11. TracedMessages.create — :516 — wraps Anthropic calls to record model_request/model_response/model_error span events.
(Non-emitting support: turn_scope/agent_scope/model_scope/restore_context at :372/:380/:397/:415 only stamp per-event context onto subsequent records.)
